column1: Bonds, we have bad news. Jessie Bains has escaped Lytton City Jail!
column2: 「邦茲，有個壞消息。傑西．班恩斯從萊頓市監獄逃走了！」

column1: Not only has he escaped, the Captain says,"but he took the jailer as hostage!"
column2: 警監說：「他不只逃走了，還把獄卒抓來當人質！」

column1: Bonds, I've named you and your partner, Keith, to a special task force with the code name of Target."
column2: 「邦茲，我已經指派你和搭檔基斯加入一支特別工作小組，代號是『目標』。」

column1: The Captain continues:"I want you boys to answer any and all calls that might be even remotely connected to this dirtbag!"
column2: 警監繼續說：「任何可能與這個混蛋有一點關聯的通報，你們都要處理！」

column1: The Captain orders you: "Find a mug shot of that punk, and get on this immediately!"
column2: 警監命令你：「找出那個混蛋的嫌犯照片，立刻開始辦案！」

column1: You have your orders, Bonds!
column2: 「你已經接到命令了，邦茲！」

column1: You're wasting valuable time, Bonds!
column2: 「你正在浪費寶貴時間，邦茲！」

column1: You're a detective. Start earning your money!
column2: 「你是警探，開始做出成績！」

column1: Bonds, says the Captain, "go ahead and take off. You've earned your daily dollar."
column2: 警監說：「邦茲，去吧。你今天的薪水已經賺到了。」

column1: You're on your own time boy....Go somewhere!
column2: 「現在是你自己的時間，小子……去辦案吧！」

column1: Hey Bonds! the Captain blurts. "We have a traffic cop standing by down in the old warehouse district with a 187 victim."
column2: 「嘿，邦茲！」警監脫口說道。「舊倉庫區有一名交通警員守著一具 187 案受害者的遺體。」

column1: Continuing, the Captain says: "The victim took it in the back of the head. Looks like it could be a professional hit."
column2: 警監接著說：「受害者後腦中槍，看起來可能是職業殺手所為。」

column1: Sonny! The address is 160 West Rose. Take Keith and get over there!
column2: 「桑尼！地址是西玫瑰街 160 號。帶基斯過去！」

column1: Keith just told me about the motel incident! the Captain says in an excited voice.
column2: 「基斯剛告訴我汽車旅館的事！」警監興奮地說。

column1: Good thing Keith was there with you, keeping a cool head and following procedures.
column2: 「幸好基斯當時和你在一起，保持冷靜並遵守程序。」

column1: The Captain continues... "I've been thinking....I don't like what I see."
column2: 警監繼續說……「我一直在想……我不喜歡目前看到的情況。」

column1: Point #1: says Fletch, "The murder victim, Woody Roberts, testified against Bains at his trial last year."
column2: 弗萊奇說：「第一點：謀殺案受害者伍迪．羅伯茲去年曾在班恩斯的審判中作證。」

column1: Point #2: he continues, "Bonds, you also testified against Bains last year."
column2: 他繼續說：「第二點：邦茲，你去年也曾在班恩斯的審判中作證。」

column1: Point #3: You were led into a booby trap at the motel. If you ask me, he says, "this whole thing is shaping up as a vendetta!"
column2: 「第三點：你在汽車旅館被引進陷阱。他說：「依我看，整件事正在變成一場復仇！」

column1: In a worried tone of voice, the Captain says,"You boys better start digging. We appear to have a vengeful maniac on our hands!"
column2: 警監擔憂地說：「你們最好開始深入調查。我們手上似乎有一個尋仇的瘋子！」

column1: Barely able to contain your emotions, you quickly tell Captain Hall about the signs of a struggle at Marie's.
column2: 你幾乎壓抑不住情緒，迅速告訴霍爾警監瑪麗家中有打鬥痕跡。

column1: Sorry to hear about Marie, Sonny, Captain Fletcher offers.
column2: 弗萊徹警監說：「桑尼，聽到瑪麗的消息我很遺憾。」

column1: If you boys have a solid lead, now's the time to bring it up.
column2: 「你們如果有可靠線索，現在就提出來。」

column1: The Captain takes the victim list from you and begins to read.
column2: 警監從你手中接過受害者名單，開始閱讀。

column1: Captain Fletcher Hall says, "While you were out, I dug around in the files and came up with a list of folks who testified against Bains."
column2: 弗萊徹．霍爾警監說：「你外出時，我翻查了檔案，整理出一份曾指證班恩斯的人員名單。」

column1: They are... he says, reading the list, "Woody Roberts, Don Colby, Marie Wilkans, and Sonny Bonds."
column2: 他讀著名單說：「他們是……伍迪．羅伯茲、唐．柯比、瑪麗．威爾肯斯，以及桑尼．邦茲。」

column1: Huummm. the Captain mumbles. "Everyone on this list testified against Bains, and are now either dead or missing. Except you and Colby."
column2: 警監喃喃說：「嗯……名單上的每個人都曾指證班恩斯，如今不是死亡就是失蹤。除了你和柯比。」

column1: The question is, Sonny: will he go after you or Colby next?
column2: 「問題是，桑尼：他下一個會對你或柯比下手？」

column1: Captain Hall takes the card from you. "So, Bains knows where Colby is!"
column2: 霍爾警監從你手中接過卡片。「所以班恩斯知道柯比在哪裡！」

column1: This chump Bains, he continues, "most likely has kidnapped Marie to use her as a hostage. He's trying to sucker you into another set-up, Bonds."
column2: 「這個蠢貨班恩斯，」他繼續說，「很可能綁架瑪麗當人質。他想誘使你，邦茲，再次落入圈套。」

column1: A maniac like Bains is hard to read, boys, Captain Hall muses. "You've got a blank check to proceed however you feel is best."
column2: 霍爾警監沉思道：「班恩斯這種瘋子很難預測。你們可以自行判斷，以你們認為最好的方式行動。」

column1: Colby's where-abouts are unknown to Bains, Captain Hall thinks aloud, "so Bains will probably stick around to take another crack at you, Sonny."
column2: 霍爾警監自言自語：「班恩斯不知道柯比的下落，所以他可能會留下來，再找機會對你下手，桑尼。」

column1: I'll book this evidence for you. You'd better decide what to do next... and FAST!
column2: 「我會替你登錄這些證物。你最好決定下一步要做什麼……而且要快！」

column1: Your partner Keith takes a deep puff and says:
column2: 你的搭檔基斯深吸一口氣說：

column1: Say, Sonny...I heard that dirtbag you sent up the river last year is back in town for retrial. Isn't his name Bains, or something like that?
column2: 「欸，桑尼……我聽說你去年送進牢裡的那個混蛋回城接受重審了。他是不是叫班恩斯，還是類似的名字？」

column1: Maybe this time you can put him away for the duration.
column2: 「也許這次你能讓他在牢裡待到刑期結束。」
